work_item: B04 ordinary CLI CSV/JSON first-seen group-count routes and explicit groups projection follow-up
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Explicit table input -> sealed input -> unique Core -> first-seen exact-string group counts with original member evidence and typed stops -> caller-declared downstream consumption
three_document_set: N/A; no construction three-document set specified
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json
initial_state: CSV and JSON table group-count operations existed through ordinary Core intents; their initial validation records were build-only. This follow-up adds tests/evidence only and makes no production implementation or grammar change.

tests_and_route.route_method: Tests launch minidora-rust with --json and fresh real stores, read actual dependencies with actor/case-checked Store::get_bytes, and inspect original requests and complete results in separate CLI processes. Actual displayed count-report bytes become new explicit groups-projection requests.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; tests/evidence-only batch with four focused normal-route tests and workspace all-target compile/lint.

route_observations.span_contract: One CSV_GROUP_COLUMN plus N CSV_GROUP_MEMBER plus G CSV_GROUP_VALUE spans: 25 for 14 rows/10 groups, 1 for header-only. Every expected (kind,row) occurs exactly once, with exact original UTF-8 byte ranges/raw text/decoded values and column 1. Header/representative spans have exact displayed JSON token offsets; member output offsets are null.
route_observations.empty_member: The unquoted empty cell in row 12 (1-based CSV data row) has a legitimate zero-width source range and joins the quoted empty cell. This is checked without requiring positive span length.
route_observations.report_shape: Displayed groups contain value/count, not explicit member-index arrays; the DocumentResult dependency retains member source spans. Header-only input yields groups=[] and counts 0.

route_observations.member_evidence: Each group has the exact independent value/count/source_row_indices in first-seen order; every original 0-based row 0..13 appears exactly once. Every header/member range and SHA-256 is checked against the original JSON raw token, including Unicode escapes. Empty rows retain the group-by header range and yield groups=[].

route_observations.route: CSV or JSON actual group-count report -> explicit JsonObjectProject groups
route_observations.evidence: Actual count text is submitted as json-object-project ["groups"] input. The projected JSON equals the actual report groups, including JSON member metadata where present. Stored source/output hashes and complete root-field raw value/output maps are checked.
route_observations.composition_boundary: Caller-fed explicit composition; no inferred Core plan, automatic report-to-table adaptation or strict columns/rows table output is claimed.

route_observations.route: Missing columns, malformed inputs and unsupported header suffixes

cases.input: CSV header with and send suffix
JSON header with and send suffix

key_semantics_observed: Quoted/unquoted CSV lexemes and raw/escaped JSON strings group by their decoded string. Case, leading/trailing spaces, numeric-looking 001 versus 1, and precomposed versus decomposed Unicode remain distinct. No trimming, case folding, numeric conversion or Unicode normalization is inferred.
render_and_persistence_evidence: All positive cases check COMMIT/COMPUTED, RENDERED, displayed text hash/content-plan equality, one actor/case-authorized dependency, original request/body and complete result via separate inspect. Actual groups projection checks exact stored source/output hashes and selected raw value bytes.
oracle_scope: Explicit fixed groups/member indices are independent expected values. Unique row IDs locate raw cell tokens; quoted empty and zero-width unquoted empty are both covered. CSV group JSON tokens are unique within these reports. JSON raw key-token spelling is supplied explicitly for escaped rows. Claims apply to these authored fixtures, not a held-out population.

retained_local_evidence.remote_storage_verification: NOT_RUN; local diagnostic-state/log retention only, no OneDrive storage claim

known_limits: These authored examples are scoped QC, not an independent held-out B04 acceptance population.
Count reports are metadata-bearing objects and are not strict columns/rows tables. Only explicit groups root-field projection is observed as downstream consumption here.

General aggregation/structured transformation populations, unobserved operations, full workspace runtime regression, external LIVE evaluation, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, release and deployment are NOT_RUN.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; selected ordinary group-count and typed-stop routes observed, not the complete B04 contract
